explanation: Variant of erdosproblems.com/686 restricted to perfect squares N ≥ 2. The page states only the general question; the restriction is motivated by the fact (proved in this file as non_square, and discussed in the problem's forum thread) that every non-square N is representable already with k = 2 via a Pell equation, so squares are the remaining open case. The statement uses the same representation predicate as erdos_686 with the extra hypothesis IsSquare N. Correctly stated sub-question.
